messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] continuous-batch perf cliff detected on cluster rg-fall-3. p95 latency ↑ 8x, error rate ↑ 12% over 2m. Auto-pager -> @oncall-eric
oncall-eric: I'm on it, jumping into the call channel.
oncall-eric: quick triage: kvcache evictions spiked, effective kvcache-size dropped ~60% in last 3m.
sre-anna: router nodes show queue growth and many microbatches collapsing to size=1, causing overhead + scheduling churn.
eng-maya: I rolled out adaptive-prefetch v2 (canary->prod) around 10:12 UTC, marking as possible suspect.
infra-raj: confirmed rollout id v2-prefetch @ 2026-03-17T10:12:23Z. Suggest revert if correlated.
oncall-eric: collecting traces/logs first. @eng-maya can you flip the feature flag to revert canary?
eng-maya: revert in progress -> `/deploy revert feature:v2-prefetch`
deploy-bot: Revert initiated for feature v2-prefetch by eng-maya. Progress: 0% -> 100%, ETA ~2m.
oncall-eric: temporary mitigation: throttling prefetch multiplier from 4.0 -> 1.2 manually on controller instances.
sre-anna: routing: shifting traffic to fallback model variant `fallback-slow` to reduce KV pressure, applied rule at router layer.
ops-log: ```
2026-03-17T10:19:05Z router0 WARN batch_queue_length=212 microbatch_ms=2 kv_evicted=3412 pref_mult=4.0
2026-03-17T10:19:07Z runtime WARN inflight=780 latency_p95=820ms errors_5xx=58
```
oncall-eric: customer impact snapshot: ShopHub seeing increased 500s (~8% of their requests), EduFlow high latency but low error rate so far.
support-bot: Ticket created #SUP-8342 for ShopHub (SLA risk flagged). CS and AMs notified.
eng-maya: revert complete at 10:21:30 UTC, re-enabled old prefetch heuristics.
deploy-bot: Revert completed successfully at 2026-03-17T10:21:30Z. No node restarts required.
sre-anna: metrics: KV evictions dropping, microbatch median size recovering to ~8 tokens, p95 latency trending down.
oncall-eric: monitoring for 10m window. Opening incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian/INC-1766543211 (will fill impact details).
infra-raj: recommended hotfix: cap prefetch multiplier in controller config (max_pref_mult=2.0) and add alert on pref_mult > 2.5.
eng-maya: will open PR with cap + unit tests and canary gating for pref heuristic.
oncall-eric: handoff note: night oncall @sre-lisa in ~20m — adding context to handoff doc.
sre-lisa: ack, I’ll take post-mitigation watch at 10:40 and verify no regressions.
oncall-eric: final summary for thread: impact window ~10:18–10:23 UTC. ShopHub: ~5min elevated 500s (mitigated by revert + routing fallback). EduFlow: latency spike only. Root cause likely unbounded prefetch multiplier in v2 causing kvcache eviction cascade under high concurrency.
incident-bot: Incident closed by oncall-eric at 2026-03-17T10:28:31Z (severity: S2). Reason: feature rollback + routing fallback reduced load.
eng-maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4521 (cap prefetch + alert).
sre-anna: adding a synthetic high-concurrency perf regression test for pref_mult blowouts to CI.
oncall-eric: closing thread here, will update handoff doc and postmortem template, include customer comms draft. :white_check_mark:
